Name: Willy Is A Professional
Author: frozenoj
Description: Removes one line from the To The Beach quest cutscene where you get your bamboo pole from Willy. Every time he says I finally got a new rod and then gives you his old bamboo pole it irritates me thinking this man has been using the second worst rod until now. I thought about replacing the line about him getting a new rod or making it seem like the bamboo pole wasn't the one he was replacing but couldn't get it to feel right so just left it out.

Manifest.Name: Willy Is A Professional
Manifest.Description: Willy no longer implies he's been using a bamboo pole his whole life.'
Manifest.Author: frozenoj
